string-array.name: import_microsoft_steps
string-array.item: Microsoft Authenticator can\'t export its accounts: its only backup is to a Microsoft account, in a form that only it can read.
Set each account up again instead. Open the site\'s two-factor settings, turn the authenticator off and on, and scan the new QR code with CometOTP.
Only remove an account from Microsoft Authenticator once a code from CometOTP has signed you in there.

resources.string: Work or school accounts that use the app\'s own sign-in approval, rather than a code, stay in Microsoft Authenticator.
